lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਡੁਬੇ ਚਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਮਹਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਦੀਏ ਬਹਾਇ ॥੧੦੪॥
lines.transliteration: aap dube chahu bed mahi chele deee bahaai ||104||
lines.translation: He himself is drowning in the four Vedas; he drowns his disciples as well. ||104||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਖੇ ਤਲੈ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jete paap keee raakhe talai duraai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, whatever sins the mortal has committed, he tries to keep hidden under cover.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਸਭ ਜਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧੦੫॥
lines.transliteration: paragat bhae nidaan sabh jab poochhe dharam raai ||105||
lines.translation: But in the end, they shall all be revealed, when the Righteous Judge of Dharma investigates. ||105||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਲਿਓ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer har kaa simaran chhaad kai paalio bahut kuta(n)b ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, you have given up meditating on the Lord, and you have raised a large family.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਰਹਿਆ ਨ ਬੰਧੁ ॥੧੦੬॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa karataa rahi gaiaa bhaaee rahiaa na ba(n)dh ||106||
lines.translation: You continue to involve yourself in worldly affairs, but none of your brothers and relatives remain. ||106||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਜਗਾਵਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer har kaa simaran chhaad kai raat jagaavan jaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, those who give up meditation on the Lord, and get up at night to wake the spirits of the dead,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਅਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਏ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖਾਇ ॥੧੦੭॥
lines.transliteration: sarapan hoi kai autarai jaae apune khaai ||107||
lines.translation: shall be reincarnated as snakes, and eat their own offspring. ||107||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਅਹੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer har kaa simaran chhaad kai ahoee raakhai naar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the woman who gives up meditation on the Lord, and observes the ritual fast of Ahoi,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਦਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਅਉਤਰੈ ਭਾਰੁ ਸਹੈ ਮਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੦੮॥
lines.transliteration: gadahee hoi kai autarai bhaar sahai man chaar ||108||
lines.translation: shall be reincarnated as a donkey, to carry heavy burdens. ||108||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer chaturaaee at ghanee har jap hiradai maahi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, it is the most clever wisdom, to chant and meditate on the Lord in the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੀ ਊਪਰਿ ਖੇਲਨਾ ਗਿਰੈ ਤ ਠਾਹਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧੦੯॥
lines.transliteration: sooree oopar khelanaa girai ta thaahar naahi ||109||
lines.translation: It is like playing on a pig; if you fall off, you will find no place of rest. ||109||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋੁਈ ਮੁਖੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer souee mukh dha(n)n hai jaa mukh kaheeai raam ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, blessed is that mouth, which utters the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਾਪੁਰੀ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਗ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: dehee kis kee baapuree pavitr hoigo graam ||110||
lines.translation: It purifies the body, and the whole village as well. ||110||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋਈ ਕੁਲ ਭਲੀ ਜਾ ਕੁਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer soee kul bhalee jaa kul har ko daas ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, that family is good, in which the Lord's slave is born.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲ ਦਾਸੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਕੁਲ ਢਾਕੁ ਪਲਾਸੁ ॥੧੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jih kul daas na oopajai so kul dhaak palaas ||111||
lines.translation: But that family in which the Lord's slave is not born is as useless as weeds. ||111||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹੈ ਗਇ ਬਾਹਨ ਸਘਨ ਘਨ ਲਾਖ ਧਜਾ ਫਹਰਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer hai gai baahan saghan ghan laakh dhajaa phaharaahi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, some have lots of horses, elephants and carriages, and thousands of banners waving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਭਿਖੵਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: iaa sukh te bhikhyaa bhalee jau har simarat din jaahi ||112||
lines.translation: But begging is better than these comforts, if one spends his days meditating in remembrance on the Lord. ||112||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਮਾਂਦਲੁ ਕੰਧ ਚਢਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer sabh jag hau phirio maa(n)dal ka(n)dh chadhaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I have wandered all over the world, carrying the drum on my shoulder.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਬਜਾਇ ॥੧੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: koee kaahoo ko nahee sabh dekhee thok bajaai ||113||
lines.translation: No one belongs to anyone else; I have looked and carefully studied it. ||113||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਬੀਥਰੇ ਅੰਧਾ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maarag motee beethare a(n)dhaa nikasio aai ||
lines.translation: The pearls are scattered on the road; the blind man comes along.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਲੰਘੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jot binaa jagadees kee jagat ula(n)ghe jaai ||114||
lines.translation: Without the Light of the Lord of the Universe, the world just passes them by. ||114||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਾ ਬੰਸੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਪੂਤੁ ਕਮਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: boodaa ba(n)s kabeer kaa upajio poot kamaal ||
lines.translation: My family is drowned, O Kabeer, since the birth of my son Kamaal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੇ ਆਯਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa simaran chhaad kai ghar le aayaa maal ||115||
lines.translation: He has given up meditating on the Lord, in order to bring home wealth. ||115||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਨੇ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer saadhoo kau milane jaaeeai saath na leejai koi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, go out to meet the holy man; do not take anyone else with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਉ ਨ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: paachhai paau na deejeeai aagai hoi s hoi ||116||
lines.translation: Do not turn back - keep on going. Whatever will be, will be. ||116||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਤਿਹ ਮਤ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jag baadhio jih jevaree tih mat ba(n)dhahu kabeer ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, do not bind yourself with that chain, which binds the whole world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਹਹਿ ਆਟਾ ਲੋਨ ਜਿਉ ਸੋਨ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੧੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: jaihahi aataa lon jiu son samaan sareer ||117||
lines.translation: As the salt is lost in the flour, so shall your golden body be lost. ||117||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਿਓ ਤਨੁ ਗਾਡਿਓ ਸੋਝਾਈ ਸੈਨਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ha(n)s udio tan gaadio sojhaaee sainaah ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the soul-swan is flying away, and the body is being buried, and still he makes gestures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਹੂ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਰੰਕਾਈ ਨੈਨਾਹ ॥੧੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: ajahoo jeeu na chhodaee ra(n)kaaee nainaah ||118||
lines.translation: Even then, the mortal does not give up the cruel look in his eyes. ||118||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨੈਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਤੁਅ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer nain nihaarau tujh kau sravan sunau tu naau ||
lines.translation: Kabeer: with my eyes, I see You, Lord; with my ears, I hear Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਨ ਉਚਰਉ ਤੁਅ ਨਾਮ ਜੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਠਾਉ ॥੧੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: bain ucharau tu naam jee charan kamal rid thaau ||119||
lines.translation: With my tongue I chant Your Name; I enshrine Your Lotus Feet within my heart. ||119||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer surag narak te mai rahio satigur ke parasaad ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I have been spared from heaven and hell, by the Grace of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਮਉਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਅੰਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਆਦਿ ॥੧੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kee mauj mahi rahau a(n)t ar aad ||120||
lines.translation: From beginning to end, I abide in the joy of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||120||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਮਉਜ ਕੋ ਕਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਨਮਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer charan kamal kee mauj ko kahi kaise unamaan ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, how can I even describe the extent of the joy of the Lord's Lotus Feet?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਬੇ ਕਉ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖਾ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahibe kau sobhaa nahee dekhaa hee paravaan ||121||
lines.translation: I cannot describe its sublime glory; it has to be seen to be appreciated. ||121||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਹ ਕਹਉ ਕਹੇ ਨ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer dekh kai kih kahau kahe na ko pateeaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, how can I describe what I have seen? No one will believe my words.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਉਹੀ ਰਹਉ ਹਰਖਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: har jaisaa taisaa uhee rahau harakh gun gaai ||122||
lines.translation: The Lord is just as He is. I dwell in delight, singing His Glorious Praises. ||122||
